svg.title: Suspicious activity detection with three video models
svg.desc: Animated comparison: a 16-frame clip is fed to I3D, SlowFast and VideoMAE. Test accuracy: I3D 76.96%, SlowFast 76.96%, VideoMAE 71.65%; best validation 83.08%, 79.04% and 72.73%. Output classes: adult content, harmful content, safe, suicide.
